question: How do I create a kMeet meeting?
answer:
To create a kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. **Start kMeet**: Go to [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or open the kMeet application on your computer or mobile device.
2. **Start a new meeting**: Click on the option to start a new meeting.
3. **Enter a name**: Provide a name for your meeting room.
4. **Allow access**: Grant access to your webcam and microphone if prompted by your browser or application.
5. **Enter your name**: Specify your name or pseudonym for the meeting.
6. **Configure security options** (optional):
   - Enable participant control, a password, or a custom encryption key if needed.
7. **Join the meeting**: Click on **Join the meeting**.
8. **Share the meeting link**: Share the meeting link with participants to invite them to join.

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2475/create-a-kmeet-meeting).

question: How can I share my screen during a kMeet call?
key_points: choose entire screen or specific window
answer:
To share your screen during a kMeet call, follow these steps:

1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.
2. Create or join a meeting room.
3. Click on the screen icon with an arrow to **Share your screen**.
4. Read the warning that may be displayed by your device and validate the authorization to access the screen content.
5. By default, it is the **entire** screen that will be shared in the next step, but you can also choose a **specific window**, that of an application for example, in order to restrict the participants' view to a specific activity of the device.
6. Click the button to start the **sharing**.
7. To stop the broadcast, click again on the toolbar icon.

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2477/share-your-screen-on-kmeet).

question: What should I do if my audio is not working in kMeet?
answer:
If your audio is not working in kMeet, follow these steps to troubleshoot the issue:

1. **Reauthorize Multimedia Access**:
   - Go to the kMeet **Settings** (click on the icon at the top right of the interface).
   - Reactivate the permissions for the microphone and camera.
   - Ensure no lock icon in your browser's address bar is blocking multimedia access.

2. **Check Multimedia Settings on Mobile Devices**:
   - For **iOS**:
     - Go to **Settings > Privacy & Security**.
     - Ensure kMeet has access to the **Microphone**.
   - For **Android**:
     - Open **Settings > Apps > kMeet > Permissions**.
     - Ensure the microphone permission is set to **Allow**.

3. **Windows Troubleshooter**:
   - Go to **Windows Settings > Privacy**.
   - Enable **Allow apps to access the microphone**.
   - Run the **Audio Troubleshooter** if the issue persists.

4. **Join the Meeting from a Different Device**:
   - If the issue persists, try joining the meeting from another device (e.g., switch from a computer to a mobile device).

5. **Disable WebRTC in Firefox (if applicable)**:
   - Open Firefox and type `about:config` in the address bar.
   - Find `media.peerconnection.enabled` and set it to **false**.
   - Rejoin the meeting.

For more detailed instructions, refer to the [Fix an audio issue on kMeet](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2441/fix-an-audio-issue-on-kmeet) guide.

question: How do I create side rooms (breakout rooms) in kMeet?
key_points: moderator can force participants to join
answer:
To create side rooms (breakout rooms) in kMeet, follow these steps:

1. Start kMeet as a moderator via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computer or mobile devices.
2. Once the participants are in the meeting, click on the multi-user icon in the kMeet toolbar.
3. Click the button to add a side room.
4. Participants can then join the created room or leave it by displaying the menu with the same button as in step 2 above.
5. The moderator can also force one of the participants to join one of the side rooms by clicking on the action menu on the right in the list.

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2397/create-a-kmeet-meeting-side-room).

question: How can I record a kMeet meeting?
answer:
To record a kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. **Prerequisites**:
   - You must have a kDrive (standalone or as part of a kSuite).
   - You must be the moderator of the video conference.
   - The meeting must not be encrypted with a custom key.

2. **Steps to Record**:
   - Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the apps for computers and mobile devices.
   - Once in the meeting, click on the action menu **○○○** in the kMeet toolbar.
   - Click on the icon ◉ **Start recording**.
   - Confirm the operation and, if necessary, log in to your Infomaniak account.
   - Select a kDrive to record the video conference on and click the button to start.
   - To stop recording, click on the toolbar again, then choose **Stop recording**.
   - Confirm and choose whether you want to go to the recording location on kDrive.
   - The recording will be available at the root of the chosen kDrive as soon as the virtual room in which the meeting was held is closed (i.e., as soon as all participants have left the video conference).

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2472/save-a-kmeet-meeting-on-kdrive).

question: How do I set a password for my kMeet meeting?
answer:
To set a password for your kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.
2. Start a new meeting.
3. Enter a name for your meeting room.
4. Click on the security options.
5. Enable the toggle switch to Protect access.
6. Create the password.
7. Continue to start the meeting.
8. Specify the name you want to use as a participant in the meeting.
9. Share the meeting link or code and the password (which you can re-display at this step) with your participants.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2464/secure-a-kmeet-meeting-with-a-password-and-encryption-key).

question: How can I livestream a kMeet meeting?
answer:
To livestream a kMeet meeting, you can use the **Video Streaming Broadcast** feature. This allows you to share the kMeet feed via Video Streaming, which is useful for avoiding dependency on the connection to kMeet.

Here’s how to do it:
1. Start your kMeet meeting as usual.
2. Use the **Video Streaming Broadcast** feature to stream the meeting feed.

For more details, refer to the guide on [Streaming the kMeet feed via Video Streaming](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1355).

question: How do I install kDrive on Linux?
key_points: Lite Sync not available on Linux
answer:
To install kDrive on Linux, follow these steps:

1. **Prerequisites**:
   - Ensure you have a Linux distribution supported by Infomaniak (e.g., Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or later).
   - Download the kDrive AppImage file for Linux.
   - Install Fuse2, which is required to run the AppImage file. On Ubuntu 23.04 or later, you may need to install it manually:
     ```bash
     sudo apt install libfuse2
     ```
   - Ensure you have D-Bus and either Gnome-keyring or kwallet installed (usually pre-installed on most systems).

2. **Installation Steps**:
   - Place the downloaded AppImage file in a folder (e.g., "Applications").
   - Right-click on the file and select **Permissions**.
   - Check the box labeled **Allow executing file as a program**.

3. **Additional Operations (Optional)**:
   - To run kDrive at startup on Ubuntu, add the file to *Startup Application Preferences*.
   - If the icon is missing on Gnome, install [AppIndicator](https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/615/appindicator-support/).

For more details, refer to the official guide: [Install kDrive on Linux](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/617/install-kdrive-on-linux).

question: How can I share a file from kDrive?
key_points: recipients can create free Infomaniak account
answer:
To share a file from kDrive, follow these steps:

1. Access the Infomaniak kDrive Web app by clicking [here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).
2. Navigate to the file you want to share.
3. Right-click on the file and select the **Share** option.
4. Choose the sharing method:
   - **Public Share Link**: Activate the public share link and adjust the security settings as needed. Copy the link to send it or send it directly from the window.
   - **Invite Specific Users**: Enter the email address of the user(s) you want to share the file with. You can choose whether they can modify the file or not.
5. Click **Send the invitation** or copy the link to share it with your contacts.

For more details, refer to the [Manage Sharing of the Organization's kDrive Folders](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1793/manage-sharing-of-the-common-folder-on-kdrive) guide.

question: What is a Drop Box in kDrive and how do I create one?
key_points: can set password, expiration, storage limit
answer:
A **Drop Box** in kDrive is a feature that allows you to create a shared folder where external contacts can deposit files directly into your kDrive. This is useful for collecting files from clients, partners, or collaborators without giving them full access to your kDrive.

### How to Create a Drop Box in kDrive

1. **Access kDrive**:
   - Go to the [kDrive Web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).

2. **Navigate to the Desired Folder**:
   - Choose the folder where you want the Drop Box to be created. You can use your personal folder ("My Folder") for private data or a shared folder ("Organization Folders") if you want other users to access the data.

3. **Create the Drop Box**:
   - Click on the blue **New** button.
   - Select **Drop Box** from the menu.

4. **Configure the Drop Box**:
   - Enter a **name** for the Drop Box.
   - The full path to the Drop Box location will be displayed for your reference.
   - Decide whether to restrict access to your user only or allow access to other users in the Organization.

5. **Create the Drop Box**:
   - Click the blue **Create** button.

6. **Share the Drop Box**:
   - Share the link to the Drop Box or send it via email to your contacts.
   - You can also customize advanced options, such as receiving email notifications, setting a password, adding an expiration date, or limiting storage space.

### Advanced Options
- **Email Notifications**: Receive an email when a file is deposited.
- **Password Protection**: Secure the Drop Box with a password.
- **Expiration Date**: Set a date after which the Drop Box will no longer be accessible.
- **Storage Limit**: Limit the amount of storage space the Drop Box can use.

For more details, refer to the [official guide on managing kDrive Drop Boxes](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2386/manage-kdrive-drop-boxes).

question: How do I resolve sync conflicts in kDrive?
key_points: conflicts when same file modified locally and online
can keep both, delete, or merge
answer:
To resolve sync conflicts in kDrive, follow these steps:

1. **Identify the Conflict**:
   - Conflicts often arise when the same file is modified on multiple devices or by multiple users simultaneously.
   - Conflicted files may appear with a "Conflict" label or a duplicate file name (e.g., "filename_conflict").

2. **Resolve the Conflict**:
   - Open the kDrive application or web interface.
   - Navigate to the folder containing the conflicted file.
   - Identify the conflicted file(s) (they may have a specific label or naming convention).
   - Compare the versions of the file to determine which changes to keep.
   - Rename or merge the files as needed to resolve the conflict.

3. **Prevent Future Conflicts**:
   - Ensure that only one user edits a file at a time.
   - Use the "Lock" feature in kDrive to prevent others from editing a file while you are working on it.
   - Regularly sync your files to avoid prolonged conflicts.

For more details, refer to the kDrive documentation: [Sync kDrive across different devices](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2374/sync-kdrive-across-different-devices). If the issue persists, consider checking for any firewall or antivirus interference, as described in the guide: [Resolve a kDrive block (antivirus, firewall, etc.)](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1822/resolve-a-kdrive-block-antivirus-firewall-etc).

question: How do I manage user rights in kDrive?
key_points: don't confuse Manager rights with kDrive rights
answer:
To manage user rights in kDrive, you can follow these steps:

### Modify a kDrive User's Permissions

1. **Access kDrive**:
   - Go to the [kDrive Web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).

2. **Select the Relevant kDrive**:
   - Check or select the relevant kDrive in the dropdown menu of the left sidebar.

3. **Manage Users**:
   - Click on the action menu **⋮** located to the right of the relevant item.
   - Click on **Manage users**.

4. **Modify Rights**:
   - Manage the desired user's rights by choosing the desired access level:
     - **Administrator**: Grants full access, including sharing, statistics, activity reports, and administrative tasks.
     - **User**: Allows access to shared folders and files but restricts administrative tasks.

5. **Save Changes**:
   - Confirm the changes to update the user's permissions.

### Additional Notes

- **Organization-Level Rights**: If you encounter issues modifying permissions, ensure the user's role is correctly set at the organization level. For example, a user must be an administrator in the organization to have full rights in kDrive.
- **External Users**: External users have limited rights and are not included in the sharing of calendars and address books for the entire organization.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2365/manage-a-kdrive-users-rights).

question: How can I access kDrive files locally without downloading them?
key_points: Open kDrive Web for server files
answer:
To access kDrive files locally without downloading them, you can use the kDrive desktop application. Here are the steps:

1. **Install the kDrive desktop app** on your device (macOS, Windows, or Linux). You can download it from the [kDrive download page](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2374).

2. **Launch the kDrive app** and log in with your Infomaniak account.

3. **Access your files locally**:
   - Left-click on the kDrive app icon in the notification area of your computer.
   - Click on the action menu (⋮) at the top right.
   - Select **Open kDrive Web** to access files stored on the kDrive server or open the local folder containing your kDrive files.

4. **Enable Lite Sync** (optional): If you want to save space on your device, you can enable the Lite Sync option. This allows you to access files without downloading them fully to your device. For more details, refer to the guides for [macOS](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2608) or [Windows](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2562).

By following these steps, you can access your kDrive files locally without downloading them fully to your device.

Source: [Access kDrive files locally and online](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2456/access-kdrive-files-locally-and-online)

question: How do I sync kDrive with my Synology NAS?
key_points: Bidirectional, Download remote, or Download local sync
answer:
To sync kDrive with your Synology NAS, follow these steps:

1. **Log in** to the Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM).
2. **Install** the **Cloud Sync** app from the **Package Center** if it is not already installed.
3. **Open** the **Cloud Sync** app.
4. Click the **+** button at the bottom left to add a new cloud service.
5. Select **WebDAV** from the list of available cloud services.
6. Enter the following account details:
   - **Server address**: `https://IDkDrive.connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com` (replace `IDkDrive` with your kDrive identifier).
   - **Username**: Your email address used to log in to your Infomaniak account.
   - **Password**: Create an application-specific password for this use.
7. Select the local folder on your Synology NAS where you want to sync the files.
8. Choose the synchronization type:
   - **Bidirectional**: Changes made in either location will sync to the other.
   - **Download only remote changes**: Ideal for backing up your kDrive to your NAS.
   - **Download only local changes**: Ideal for saving data from your NAS to kDrive.
9. Confirm the settings and start the synchronization.

For more details, refer to the official guide: [Sync Synology with kDrive](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2404/sync-synology-with-kdrive)

question: How do I create a channel in kChat?
answer:
To create a channel in kChat, follow these steps:

1. Open the kChat web app by going to [ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat).
2. In the left sidebar, click on the **+** button.
3. Select **Create a new channel**.
4. Fill in the required information for the channel:
   - **Name**: Choose a name for your channel.
   - **URL**: By default, it takes the name of the channel, but you can modify it using lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes, and underscores.
   - **Status**: Choose whether the channel will be **PRIVATE** or **PUBLIC**.
   - **Description**: Add a description to specify how this channel should be used.
5. Click **Create** to finalize the creation of your channel.

For more details, refer to the [kChat documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2732/manage-a-kchat-channel).

question: How can I connect external applications to kChat?
key_points: Incoming webhooks receive from external apps
Outgoing webhooks send to external apps
POST request with JSON text field
answer:
You can connect external applications to kChat using webhooks. Here’s how:

### Steps to Connect External Applications to kChat:

1. **Access the kChat Webhooks Interface**:
   - Open the **kChat Web app** or the **kChat desktop app**.
   - Click on the **New** icon next to your kChat organization's name.
   - Select **Integrations**.

2. **Create an Incoming Webhook**:
   - Click on the category **Incoming Webhooks**.
   - Click the blue button **Add incoming webhooks**.
   - Add a name and description for the webhook.
   - Select the channel that will receive the messages.
   - Save to generate the webhook URL (keep this URL private).

3. **Use the Webhook in Your Application**:
   - Adjust the code in your application to send a POST request to the webhook URL.
   - Example request:
     ```json
     POST /hooks/xxx-key-generated-xxx HTTP/1.1
     Host: your-server-kchat.xyz
     Content-Type: application/json
     Content-Length: 63
     {
         "text": "Hello, text1\nText2."
     }
     ```
   - You can also test the webhook using `curl`:
     ```bash
     curl -i -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text": "Hello, text1\nText2."}' https://your-server-kchat.xyz/hooks/xxx-key-generated-xxx
     ```

4. **Optional Settings**:
   - You can customize the webhook with additional parameters like `channel`, `username`, and `icon_url`.
   - Example of a more complete message:
     ```json
     {
       "channel": "kchatemp",
       "username": "test-automation",
       "icon_url": "https://domain.xyz/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/icon.png",
       "text": "#### Résultats des tests pour le 27 juillet 2023\n@channel veuillez vérifier les tests échoués.\n\n| Composant  | Tests effectués   | Tests échoués                                   |\n|:-----------|:-----------:|:-----------------------------------------------|\n| Serveur     | 948         |  0                           |\n| Client Web | 123         |  2 [(voir détails)](https://linktologs) |\n| Client iOS | 78          |  3 [(voir détails)](https://linktologs) |"
     }
     ```

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2001/connect-external-applications-to-kchat).

question: How do I translate a message in kChat?
key_points: click action menu (three dots) on message
answer:
To translate a message in kChat, follow these steps:

1. Open the **kChat** web app by Infomaniak or use the mobile/desktop app.
2. View the message you want to translate.
3. Click on the **action menu •••** located at the top right of the message.
4. Select **Translate**.
5. The translated message will appear below your conversation and will only be visible to you.

For more details, you can refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1467/translate-the-content-of-a-message-on-the-kchat-infomaniak-app).

question: How can I invite external users to kChat?
key_points: external users not counted as users
answer:
To invite external users to kChat, follow these steps:

1. **Access kChat**: Open the kChat Web app or the desktop app.
2. **Invite Members**: Click the button to **Invite members**.
3. **Invite a New User**: Click the link to invite a new user.
4. **Specify Email Addresses**: Enter the email address(es) of the person(s) you want to invite.
5. **Select Channels**: Choose the channel(s) to which these users will have access.
6. **Send Invitation**: Click the blue button to send the invitation.

The invited person will receive an email with a link to join the kChat interface and the shared channel. If they do not have an Infomaniak account, they will need to create one during the registration process.

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2846/invite-an-external-user-to-use-kchat).

question: What is Euria and how do I use it in kChat?
key_points: Euria is AI assistant in kSuite
search for bot in channel search
answer:
Euria is an artificial intelligence integrated into kSuite, particularly useful in kChat for summarizing discussions and assisting with various tasks such as calculations, translations, and answering questions. Here’s how you can use Euria in kChat:

### Using Euria in kChat:

1. **Summarize a Discussion Thread**:
   - Hover over the message you want to summarize.
   - Select the Euria actions icon in the top right.
   - Click on **Summarize the discussion thread**.
   - The summary will be generated by AI and sent by kChat Bot in the right sidebar.

2. **Add Euria to Your Contacts**:
   - Euria is already part of your contacts in kChat.
   - If you don’t see it, click on the channel search in the left sidebar or the **+** icon next to **Direct Messages**.
   - Search for the bot labeled with the tag [bot] or search for terms like *bot* or *chat*.
   - Start a private discussion with Euria and interact with it as you would with any other contact.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2480/use-euria-on-kchat-summarize-a-discussion) and [conversational agent guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2840/use-euria-on-kchat-conversational-agent).
